cover.jp_line1: 不在票が入っていたので、
cover.jp_line2: 再配達をお願いします！
cover.grammar_tag: JLPT N4 Grammar: ~ので (Polite Objective Cause / Reason)
cover.translation: 'I received a missed delivery notice, please redeliver.'
cover.context_note: Japan Post & Yamato Transport redelivery calls

slides.spoken_text: 不在連絡票が入っていたので、再配達をお願いします。
slides.meaning: I received a missed delivery slip, so I would like to request redelivery.
slides.tip: Use 'ので' instead of 'から' when talking to service representatives for a polite tone.

tokens.kana: ふざいれんらくひょうが

slides.sentence_ja: 不在連絡票が入っていたので、再配達をお願いします。

vocab.kana: ふざいれんらくひょう

slides.grammar_title: Polite Reason Pattern: Verb (Plain Form) + ので (Since / Because)
grammar_bullets: 'ので' sounds softer and more objective than 'から' when calling courier services.
Most slips (不在票) have a QR code you can scan on Line or Safari to pick a time without speaking.
You can also redirect packages to your local 7-Eleven or FamilyMart.
